== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Keanos is a dog belonging to a woman who possesses the ability to levitate. The animal serves as a companion and tracker for [[Alin]], responding to verbal commands such as being told to seek out specific targets. Keanos is characterized by a loud, ringing bark and wears golden armor plating. While the hound has demonstrated an ability to track individuals from [[Alin]]'s village, there have been instances where the animal's scent-tracking led to confusion or incorrect locations.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Keanos is a large hound covered in white fur. He wears glowing gold armor and possesses bright blue eyes.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|This creature is capable of tracking by following a specific scent. He used these skills to lead [[Alin]] to a house.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Keanos is a massive hound distinguished by his bright blue eyes and thick white fur. Clad in glowing gold armor, the dog possesses a keen ability to track specific scents. While following a particular trail, Keanos successfully guided [[Alin]] directly to the house.}}
